intro: Pork Belly Pie is a savory, homemade dish baked by 'Auntie' Bernice Stonefield in Elwynn Forest. Despite the bitter, long-running feud between the Stonefield and Maclure families, young Billy Maclure cannot resist Auntie Bernice's cooking, demanding a pie as a bribe to reveal information about a lost family heirloom.

p: The Stonefield and Maclure families have nursed a bitter rivalry for years, quarreling over land and pride in the heart of Elwynn Forest. Despite this hostility, young Billy Maclure harbors a glaring weakness: he loves Auntie Bernice's famous pork belly pie. When a valuable family necklace goes missing, Billy refuses to share what he knows until an adventurer delivers him a warm slice. Bernice bakes it with great reluctance—and a pointed wish that the greedy boy chokes on it—proving that culinary reputation can sometimes breach even the stubbornest family feuds.
